editorialPolicy: Updates are selected for buyer relevance. Affiliate status, commission and partner relationships do not influence inclusion or placement.

items.label: Security update
items.title: Code scanning AI Scan enablement status in security overview
items.summary: Organization and enterprise administrators can now see AI Scan for pull requests enablement status in the security overview coverage view.

items.label: AI and automation update
items.title: Building advertising for the way people use AI
items.summary: OpenAI introduces a new visual ad format in ChatGPT and expands measurement tools, attribution partnerships, and brand suitability for advertisers.

items.label: Security update
items.title: Confidential comments on repository security advisories
items.summary: You can now post confidential comments on repository security advisories.

items.label: Security update
items.title: Repository security advisory comments API in public preview
items.summary: You can now read, add, and edit comments on repository security advisories using the REST API, including advisories created from private vulnerability reports.

items.label: Security update
items.title: New fields for SecurityAdvisory GraphQL API
items.summary: You can now read more of the GitHub Advisory Database directly from the GraphQL API without falling back to the REST API.

items.label: Product retirement
items.title: Selected models in GitHub Copilot deprecated
items.summary: As of today, October 2, 2026, we have deprecated the following models across all GitHub Copilot experiences (including Copilot Chat, inline edits, ask and agent modes, and code completions).

items.label: Integration update
items.title: Copilot code review: API support and new default effort level
items.summary: You can now request a GitHub Copilot code review through the REST and GraphQL APIs and set the review effort level for each request.

items.label: Security update
items.title: Rate limits for private vulnerability reports
items.summary: Open source maintainers are receiving more low-quality and automated vulnerability reports, which can bury the reports that matter.

items.label: Pricing and packaging update
items.title: Introducing GPT-6.1 Sol
items.summary: Meet GPT-6.1 Sol: near-Astra intelligence for coding, computer use, and professional work at one-fifth of Astra’s standard API input and output token prices.

items.label: Official product update
items.title: GitHub Copilot adds local sandboxing and agent observability
items.summary: GitHub Copilot adds local sandboxing, OpenTelemetry agent monitoring and expanded model choice for software teams.

items.label: Official product update
items.title: ChatGPT Images 2.5 sharpens editing and speeds up generation
items.summary: ChatGPT Images 2.5 improves detail, editing precision and generation speed while adding templates, sketch-based creation and prompt sharing.

items.label: Security update
items.title: GitHub adds fresh authentication for high-impact enterprise actions
items.summary: GitHub Enterprise Cloud can now require fresh re-authentication or MFA before managed users perform sensitive actions such as creating tokens or editing webhooks.

items.label: Security update
items.title: GitHub sets new SSH security requirements for keys and clients
items.summary: GitHub is phasing out older SSH cryptography, raising the minimum size for newly uploaded RSA keys and adding a post-quantum key exchange option.

items.label: AI and automation update
items.title: Introducing GPT-6 Sol and Luna
items.summary: Meet GPT-6 Sol and Luna, two models that bring frontier intelligence to everyday work with different balances of capability and cost.

items.label: Product retirement
items.title: Notion Mail shuts down as Notion shifts email workflows to AI
items.summary: Notion Mail shuts down across all plans on 22 September while Gmail-connected AI features and agent email tools remain available.

items.label: Official product update
items.title: ChatGPT arrives in Microsoft Word across all plans
items.summary: OpenAI has added ChatGPT to Microsoft Word, bringing drafting, summarization, revision and document formatting into the Word sidebar across all ChatGPT plans.

items.label: Official product update
items.title: Zapier expands Next Gen Zaps with branching, recovery and agentic management
items.summary: Next Gen Zaps adds richer branching, nested loops, resilient error handling, human pauses and agent managed diagnosis and repair to Zapier's new automation model.

items.label: Official product update
items.title: GitHub Actions adds stronger controls over who can run workflows
items.summary: GitHub Actions workflow execution protections are now generally available, adding workflow-specific targeting, policy insights, REST APIs and safer defaults for public repositories.

items.label: Official product update
items.title: GitHub removes a setup barrier for AI Scan in pull requests
items.summary: GitHub AI Scan can now check pull requests without requiring CodeQL default setup first, reducing configuration friction for eligible GitHub Advanced Security customers.

items.label: ToolScout analysis
items.title: September software trends brief
items.summary: A buyer focused look at public product releases and recurring software themes from official vendor sources.

items.label: Official release
items.title: Notion 3.7 turns team prompts into reusable Agent skills
items.summary: Notion 3.7 adds reusable team skills, a shared skills library and portability to external AI coding agents.

items.label: Official product update
items.title: HubSpot expands its MCP server from insight to action
items.summary: HubSpot is broadening what teams can do with CRM data and actions from AI conversations through its MCP server and Claude connector.
